notes: decoder.c does exact integer mean removal (250*x - sum), runs the 4 biquads in DF2T form with Q60 coefficients and Q32 signal (rounded 64x64->128-bit products, worst-case L1 gain < 4.2, so it cannot overflow anywhere in the int16 range), computes the variances exactly with 256-bit integers, and replaces log(v0)-log(v1)+0.3>0 with v0*round(e^0.3*2^62) > v1*2^62. It matched decoder.py on the 20 public trials and on 25,000 synthetic trials (full-scale, clipped, DC-offset, near-tie down to |margin| ~5e-9), and it cross-compiles cleanly for Cortex-M0.
